$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/ncr.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). The office raises nonconformances, records their containment, decides their quantity and closes them through apps/factory-api's modules/quality/ncr (B-W2a-47), always through command(); the API keeps staff to the companies and sites their grants reach. The floor has no grant here: a problem found on the floor becomes a hold at the bench (holds.prisma) and the office raises the NCR from it (an NCR from the bench is a later step). Portal and link sessions read nothing here (no portal in W2a; an NCR report for a supplier is a PDF, W2b). Nobody deletes an NCR (it is cancelled); containment actions and decisions are removed only while the NCR is OPEN or CONTAINED (the …_quality_plant_w2a_guards triggers); a link is removed by unlinking it (the audit log keeps it). No column holds a cost or a figure per person. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

Nonconformance.about: The office raises an NCR (number from the company's NCR series), edits its problem while it is OPEN or CONTAINED, moves it through its stages and closes it with the closing signature.

NcrContainmentAction.about: The office adds, edits, completes (with evidence) and removes containment actions while the NCR is OPEN or CONTAINED.

NcrDispositionLine.about: The office decides the NCR's quantity across disposition codes, approves the decisions that need it (another person) and records each decision's stock move and follow-up record.

NcrLink.about: The office links an NCR to the records it touches and unlinks them (the row is removed; the audit log keeps it).
